title: Hearing on minority- and women-owned business contracting
summary: The Council's Contracts Committee held an oversight hearing on the City's use of minority- and women-owned business enterprises (M/WBE) in contracting, alongside four related bills. In fiscal year 2025 M/WBEs received about 5% of the $46 billion in citywide contract value, down from 6% the prior year, with women-owned and Native American-owned firms especially underrepresented. The hearing also examined bills to add Middle Eastern and North African-owned businesses to disparity studies, improve outreach and subcontractor reporting for M/WBEs, and ban city purchases of non-compostable single-use cups.
